decisions.reason: Car transporter trailers serve a steady professional and dealer segment and fit the core portfolio, though the line's absence from the 2020–2021 website observations adds some uncertainty.
Low-bed trailers are a staple of the range and were featured on the home page, so continued demand makes withdrawal unlikely.
High cover variants are a low-cost add-on to the box trailer range and are usually kept, although they could be merged into base models.
After box trailer series B was withdrawn, F is likely the remaining box trailer line, making it more important to keep despite general model-range consolidation.
